feature: Epic AI Repository Analysis and Local Development Validation
workflow_rationale: This is primarily a discovery and documentation task. The focus is on understanding the existing system, validating setup procedures, and producing documentation. No new features - only minimal fixes for blocking issues.

phases.name: Environment Setup & Dependency Installation
phases.description: Validate that pnpm install works correctly on Windows and all dependencies resolve

subtasks.description: Run pnpm install and document any warnings or errors
subtasks.notes: ENVIRONMENT RESTRICTION: The 'pnpm' command is not in the allowed commands list for this Claude Code sandbox. Cannot execute pnpm install directly. The pnpm-lock.yaml file exists (indicating project was previously set up). RECOMMENDATION: (1) This verification step must be performed manually by the developer outside the sandbox, OR (2) Add 'pnpm' to the allowed commands list. The dependency structure appears valid based on package.json analysis.

subtasks.description: Copy .env.example to .env.local and configure minimum required variables
subtasks.notes: Minimum required: DATABASE_URL (default works), CLERK_SECRET_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY

phases.name: Docker Services Validation
phases.description: Start Docker containers for PostgreSQL and Redis, verify they are healthy

subtasks.description: Start docker-compose services (postgres and redis only)

verification.command: docker-compose up -d postgres redis && docker-compose ps

subtasks.notes: Voice-service container is optional and requires additional env vars

subtasks.description: Verify PostgreSQL is accessible and accepting connections

verification.command: docker exec epic-ai-postgres pg_isready -U epic -d epic_ai

subtasks.description: Verify Redis is accessible and responding to ping

phases.name: Database Schema Validation
phases.description: Generate Prisma client and push schema to local PostgreSQL database

subtasks.description: Push database schema to local PostgreSQL
subtasks.notes: This creates all tables defined in schema.prisma

subtasks.description: Verify database tables were created successfully

verification.command: docker exec epic-ai-postgres psql -U epic -d epic_ai -c "\dt"

phases.name: Development Server Validation
phases.description: Start the Next.js development server and verify the web application loads

subtasks.description: Start development server with pnpm dev

verification.expected: Server starts without fatal errors, shows Ready on http://localhost:3000

subtasks.notes: May see Clerk authentication warnings if keys not configured - this is expected

subtasks.description: Verify web application responds at localhost:3000

checks: No fatal JavaScript errors in console

phases.name: Architecture Documentation
phases.description: Create comprehensive documentation of repository structure, services, and patterns

subtasks.description: Document all apps and packages with their purposes and tech stacks

verification.instructions: Verify ARCHITECTURE.md contains: (1) All 6 services documented, (2) Tech stack for each, (3) Entry points, (4) Production vs experimental classification

subtasks.expected_output: ARCHITECTURE.md with service inventory, dependency graph, port allocation

verification.instructions: Verify ENVIRONMENT.md contains: (1) Minimum required vars, (2) Optional feature vars, (3) Default values where applicable

subtasks.expected_output: ENVIRONMENT.md with categorized environment variable reference

phases.name: Developer Readiness Checklist
phases.description: Create actionable checklist that new developers can follow to set up local environment

subtasks.description: Create step-by-step local development setup guide

verification.instructions: Verify LOCAL_SETUP.md contains: (1) Prerequisites (pnpm, Docker, Node version), (2) Step-by-step commands, (3) Troubleshooting section for common issues

subtasks.expected_output: LOCAL_SETUP.md with complete developer onboarding guide

verification.instructions: Verify LOCAL_SETUP.md includes Windows-specific notes: path issues, Docker Desktop requirements, PowerShell vs Git Bash

subtasks.notes: Integrated into LOCAL_SETUP.md rather than separate file

phases.name: Final Validation & Sign-off
phases.description: End-to-end verification that a fresh developer can follow documentation and achieve working local environment

subtasks.description: Execute complete setup workflow from scratch and document any issues

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution - investigation workflow with dependencies

acceptance_criteria: Docker services (postgres, redis) start and show healthy
Documentation files created: ARCHITECTURE.md, ENVIRONMENT.md, LOCAL_SETUP.md
verification_strategy.reasoning: Investigation task with primary output being documentation. Validation focuses on setup workflow execution rather than code testing.
